messages:
Ashley O: FYI vendor update — H100 wave we were counting on got cut. Confirmed allocation down ~40% for the EU wave. They propose splitting the remainder across two shipments. https://vendor.example/notice :exclamation:
Priya P: numbers? which serials / how many units exactly? is it per PO or per shipment?
Lin (Vendor): Lin (Vendor): Confirmed. Production hit on one fab line. Proposal: send 60% by sea to FRA cross-dock (cheaper) and 40% by air direct to our EU hub. ETA window remains the same but lead time certainty drops. Can provide AWBs for air when booked.
Mike I: 40% loss is painful — which clusters are impacted? If this hits eu-west-1 dedicated pool we've got rollover risk.
Damien: If eu-west loses 40% of committed H100s we’ll hit autoscale triggers and saturated queues. Short term mitigation: bump up preemptible fallbacks + throttle batch jobs; but latency-sensitive workloads will see increased queuing.
Priya P: Lin, what are expedite costs for converting FRA sea -> air for the cross-dock portion? Also customs risk on split shipments?
Lin (Vendor): Expedite for the sea portion to air adds ~€1,200/unit landed (air uplift + brokerage). Customs-wise split creates two manifests: sea container -> FRA (import entry) and separate AWB for air -> direct. We can pre-clear paperwork to reduce hold risk but need EORI docs from you.
Ashley O: Can we ask vendor to prioritize dedicated commitments (eu-west-1 reserved pool) when doing the air slice? If air can go straight into our on-prem staging at FRA that helps.
Lin (Vendor): Yes, we can tag SKUs for dedicated pool priority if you confirm PO refs. We'll mark AWB descriptions with "REDWOOD-DEDICATED".
Priya P: Cost-share proposal: Redwood covers 50% of expedite uplift for the cross-dock split if vendor guarantees prioritization and serial reconciliation before handoff. Is that acceptable?
Lin (Vendor): Need formal confirmation via email but vendor legal says 50/50 is workable for this one-off. They'll need signed amendment within 24h.
Damien: Operational ask — if air AWBs arrive, can we get a manifest push to infra slack channel with serials in this format?
Damien: ```
AWB: 123-4567890
Serials: H100-XX-0001..H100-XX-0120
Destination: eu-west-1-dedicated-staging
```
RMA Bot: Created ticket RMA-4482 to track split shipment customs & serial reconciliation. Assigned to Priya and Ashley.
Mike I: Quick capacity plan: if 40% drop persists for 2 weeks, plan B is to throttle non-prod and spin up temporary Dedicated in us-east-1 via burst credits. Cost estimate ballpark: $55k/week for burst capacity plus cross-region networking. Thoughts?
Ashley O: Agree we should avoid throttling prod. Priya, if vendor signs amendment, approve 50% expedite share and I’ll greenlight the FRA cross-dock + air split. Otherwise we prep the us-east burst.
Priya P: I'll send the amendment to Lin now and loop legal. Also requesting vendor EORI template and provisional AWB placeholders.
Lin (Vendor): Sending amendment draft in 30m. Provisional AWB placeholders: ``AWB-TBD-AIR-REDWOOD``. Will push manifest to this channel when available.
Ashley O: Action items: Priya send amendment, Damien prepare quick-run capacity plan for 40% shortfall (2-day exec summary), Mike estimate cross-region burst costs, Lin to push amendment + provisional manifests.
Priya P: Got it. I'll update RMA-4482 with amendment timestamp and escalate if vendor misses 24h window. :thumbsup:
Mike I: Noted. If amendment misses window, I'll start burst-price approval thread.
Lin (Vendor): Thanks everyone — working on paperwork and serial reconciliation plan.
Ashley O: Thanks — keep updates short. We'll reconvene in this thread when amendment or AWB lands. :pray:
